description.value: Ambit Cafe is an artisan café located in Kensington Square Plaza in Burnaby, offering house-made sandwiches, wraps, soups, salads, and custom espresso drinks made with local, seasonal ingredients. The café pitches itself as a welcoming stop for 'morning commuters, quick-lunch crowd, afternoon loungers, and weekend warriors.' Cycling tourists will find a solid selection of hearty, portable food options plus third-party delivery partnerships.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ambit Cafe is a real, operating artisan café at 6552 Hastings St in Burnaby (the OSM community field incorrectly reads 'North Vancouver'). Phone number 604-423-9723 and email match OSM exactly. The menu page explicitly labels items as plant-based (PB) and gluten-friendly (GF), and the front page lists Skip The Dishes, DoorDash, and Uber Eats, confirming takeout; no bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, Wi-Fi, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM community field reads 'North Vancouver' but the website clearly places the business in Burnaby, BC V5B 1S2. Address updated to reflect the website's value.

OSM opening_hours (Mo-Fr 08:00-16:00; Sa-Su 09:00-17:00) differs from the website's front-page hours and contact-page hours, which also contradict each other — hours data appears unreliable across sources.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating artisan café with confirmed website, phone, and active menu. A useful food stop for touring cyclists on Hastings Street in Burnaby.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page labels items with '_pb = plant based' and '_gf = gluten-friendly'; examples include macro salad (PB, GF), refresh salad bowl (GF), and power salad (GF)

wow_evidence: artisan café located in Kensington Square Plaza in Burnaby
